senses.gloss: Vṛndakaṭa, n. of a locality, or (acc. to v.l.) of a yakṣa: Māy 〔75〕.

vṛndi, or vṛndī (related to Skt. vṛnda, orig. swelling, mass, as m. in Suśr. tumor; = Pali, AMg. bondi; see Edgerton, JAOS 〔69.229〕, anticipated, as I learned too late, by Lüders, KZ 〔52.106—9〕, with relevant materials not included by me; cf. voṇṭa), body (orig. solid mass or the like): vaḍḍā (see vaḍḍa) ca vṛndi (in this pāda mss. lack 3 syllables; perh. read ca vidyate vṛndi, or, ca vṛndī, which in this position makes better meter than vṛndi, bhavati) prajñā ca te na vidyate Mv 〔ii.249.19〕 (vs), so mss., you have a big body, but you have no wit; = Pali Jāt. 〔ii.160.11〕 mahatī vata te bondi na ca paññā tadūpikā. Senart failed to note the parallel and emended the text badly.
